51348693.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to RXRalpha LBD (unknown origin) by isothermal titration calorimetry

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) was performed on a MicroCal iTC200 instrument (Malvern Panalytical, Worcestershire, UK) at 25 °C. The protein (PPARγ LBD or RXRα LBD) was dialyzed against 20 mM HEPES (pH 7.5), 100 mM KCl, 1 mM DTT, 0.02% (w/v) CHAPS, and 5% (v/v) glycerol. The ligand was dissolved in the same buffer. The protein was loaded into the sample cell (200 μL) at a concentration of 10–20 μM, and the ligand was loaded into the syringe (250 μL) at a concentration of 100–200 μM. The titration consisted of 20 injections of 2 μL each, with a spacing of 120 s between injections. The stirring speed was set to 300 rpm. The data were analyzed using Origin 7.0 software (OriginLab, Northampton, MA, USA) with a one-site binding model. The binding affinity (Kd) was calculated from the binding isotherm. The heat of dilution was determined by injecting the ligand into buffer and subtracted from the raw data. The experiments were performed in triplicate.
